articles.title: Gonda BJP Chief Responds to Viral Video: “She Was Unwell, Needed Rest”
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Amid a viral video controversy, BJP's Gonda district president Amar Kishore, also known as Bam Bam, has responded to the footage showing him in a close embrace with a woman at the party office.

body.html:
Amid a viral video controversy, BJP's Gonda district president Amar Kishore, also known as Bam Bam, has responded to the footage showing him in a close embrace with a woman at the party office. The incident, recorded at 9:39 PM, shows him supporting a woman who appeared unwell, and later taking her upstairs. The video has sparked speculation and public debate.

In his statement, Amar Kishore said:
"We received a call from an active female worker that she was unwell. We went to pick her up in a car. She wanted to rest for 2–4 hours, so we brought her to the office. We gave her support as she was feeling dizzy."

While the BJP leadership has yet to issue an official response, the footage continues to circulate widely on social media.

body.html:

The incident has raised concerns, especially given the soaring temperatures in Rajasthan.

articles.title: Case Filed Against Manoharlal Dhakad After Obscene Video on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police have registered a case against Manoharlal Dhakad, accused of engaging in sexual acts with a woman in public on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway. The action came after CCTV footage of the incident, reportedly from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, went viral.

body.html:
Police have registered a case against Manoharlal Dhakad, accused of engaging in sexual acts with a woman in public on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway. The action came after CCTV footage of the incident, reportedly from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, went viral.

The video shows a Maruti car (MP14 CC 4782), registered in Dhakad’s name, stopping on the expressway, where the man and woman are seen engaging in sexual activity. The footage is dated 13 May 2025 at 8:26 PM.

Dhakad is said to be associated with the BJP, but party leaders have denied his official membership. His wife, Sohan Bai, is a BJP-supported district panchayat member. The BJP’s Mandsaur district president clarified that Dhakad is not a primary party member and his official status is unclear.

Dhakad, who also served as national minister of the Dhakad Mahasabha, has been removed from the post following the controversy. Bhanpura Police have booked him under IPC sections 294, 283, 285, 296, 34, and 3(5).

articles.title: Bareilly: Man Buried Alive as Municipal Workers Dump Sludge While He Slept Under Tree
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case of negligence, 45-year-old Sunil Kumar, a vegetable vendor in Bareilly, died after being buried alive under a trolley full of sludge dumped by municipal workers.

body.html:
In a shocking case of negligence, 45-year-old Sunil Kumar, a vegetable vendor in Bareilly, died after being buried alive under a trolley full of sludge dumped by municipal workers.

Sunil was resting under a tree near his home after work when workers, engaged in citywide drain cleaning, emptied a trolley of sludge on him without checking the area. By the time locals realized what had happened and rushed him to the hospital, he was declared dead.

Municipal officials confirmed an investigation is underway, and action will be taken against the responsible contractor for gross negligence.

articles.title: Himachal Pradesh: College Principal Arrested After Molestation Video Sparks Campus Protest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh – Himanshu Monga, Director-cum-Principal of Hydro Engineering College in Bandla, was arrested late Thursday night on charges of molesting female students, following the emergence of a disturbing video showing him allegedly molesting a girl student on a hospital...

body.html:
Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh – Himanshu Monga, Director-cum-Principal of Hydro Engineering College in Bandla, was arrested late Thursday night on charges of molesting female students, following the emergence of a disturbing video showing him allegedly molesting a girl student on a hospital bed.

The incident triggered massive outrage and led to a 4-5 hour-long protest by students on the college campus. Demonstrators burned an effigy of Monga, demanding immediate action. Police intervened and arrested the accused around 10 pm. The arrest was confirmed by Bilaspur Additional SP Shivkumar Chaudhary.

The controversy began when a former student of an engineering college in Sundar Nagar, Mandi, submitted a formal complaint to the Himachal Pradesh government, accusing Monga of past sexual misconduct. She later discovered similar allegations were surfacing at the Bandla campus as well.

In response, the government deployed an investigation committee to the college. The team recorded student testimonies and submitted its findings to the authorities. Reacting to the developments, Technical Education Minister Rajesh Dharmani expressed deep concern over the case, assuring that strict action would follow upon the conclusion of the inquiry.

Police have registered a case and confirmed that the survivor’s statement will be recorded in court on Friday. Officials have reiterated a zero-tolerance stance towards such offences, promising that justice will be delivered.

articles.title: Massive Blaze Guts Mentha Oil Factory in Badaun, UP; Storm Triggers Explosions, Injures Workers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Badaun, UP – A massive fire broke out at the Bharat Mint & Allied Chemicals mentha oil factory in Ujhani area late Wednesday night following a severe storm and high-velocity winds.

body.html:
Badaun, UP – A massive fire broke out at the Bharat Mint & Allied Chemicals mentha oil factory in Ujhani area late Wednesday night following a severe storm and high-velocity winds. The blaze erupted after the factory’s chimney collapsed, sparking a chain of explosions and igniting highly flammable chemicals stored on the premises.

Spread across more than 50 bighas, the factory was almost completely gutted. Eyewitnesses said the flames and thick smoke were visible from over 4 kilometers away.

The situation turned chaotic as around 100 nitrogen cylinders exploded inside the factory, sending shockwaves through nearby villages. Over 250 workers were present during the incident; many managed to escape, but several sustained injuries. One individual was seriously injured and admitted to the district medical college, while others were treated at local health centers.

As a precautionary measure, authorities evacuated the nearby village of Kooda Narsinghpur, home to around 20,000 people, fearing further explosions. Rescue operations continued through the night, with over 50 fire engines and more than 100 firefighters battling the blaze for several hours.

District Magistrate Avnish Kumar Rai and SSP Alok Priyadarshi were among the senior officials who reached the scene to oversee operations. Though early reports feared fatalities, officials later confirmed there were no deaths, though livestock perished in related fires that also destroyed around 100 houses in nearby villages like Jamni and Sonbudhi.

Authorities have begun assessing the economic and structural losses, which are expected to be substantial. The incident forms part of a string of fire-related tragedies in the district, all believed to be triggered by extreme weather conditions that night.
